headline: Premier League overreactions: Takeaways from first games post-international break
description: After a three-week intermission, the Premier League returned with a bang last weekend. Will Man City eventually crumble under the pressure? Is this the real Man United? Let's overreact!

headline: Hull winger Mohamed Belloumi has the last laugh after pundits' mockery
description: Mohamed Belloumi may have been the brunt of some studio jokes during the Premier League weekend, but the winger again proved why he could be the man to keep Hull City in the top flight this season.

headline: Lampard: Coventry 'feet on the ground' after Newcastle win
description: Coventry City boss Frank Lampard is not allowing his side to get carried away after they earned a thumping 4-1 home victory over Newcastle United on Monday.
